name: Horizon League Cross Country Championships
where: Clinton, PA · host Robert Morris · Youthtowne XC Course
headline: Horizon League Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Robert Morris won the women's title on its home course, edging Youngstown State, and Robert Morris senior Julia Dill won the individual race in 20:19.98 ahead of YSU's McKinley Fielding (20:28.65). Youngstown State won the men's title ahead of IU Indianapolis, and IU Indy's Izaiah Steury won the race in 23:44.70.
